; UE4SS mod list.
;
; Two ways to enable a mod:
;   1) Simplest - put an empty file named enabled.txt inside the mod folder.
;      The folder name is the mod name. No edit to this file is needed.
;   2) Or list the mod here:
;        <mod name> : 1      (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)
;
; Lines starting with ';' are ignored. The order of entries only matters if
; two mods depend on each other; otherwise any order works.
